rho_reference.unit: GAE: one counted affine group addition (doubling and P + (-P) included) = 1, plus w x native operations, w in {0, 0.1, 1}. Native set (same counters on every arm): lookup, insert, legendre, sqrt, rowop, madd, dptest, build, and for rho-neg canon, lookahead, cyctest (zero on every other arm). Recomputed natives: rho-neg = lookup + insert + dptest + canon + lookahead + cyctest; plain rho = lookup + insert + dptest; arm (a) = lookup + insert + legendre + sqrt + rowop. Cost(w) = mean over 16 runs of (gae + w * native), setup included.
